summary: The fallback per-record read path now overlaps the independent issue read with the PR/check chain via Promise.allSettled, drains both branches on failure, and preserves null-on-unreadable semantics; a fake-port regression test covers 60-record overlap, sibling draining and explicit absences, and no threshold or gate was changed.

evidence: `src/repair/loop-live-inputs.ts` fallback now runs the issue read concurrently with the PR/readChecks chain through Promise.allSettled, cutting each fallback record from three sequential round trips to two waves for the failed-batch cause named in the issue.

`tests/repair/loop-live-inputs-fallback_test.ts` drives 60 fake-port records through the failing-batch fallback and asserts at most 31_000 fake milliseconds with peak 8 concurrent reads, plus unchanged-input skips and only the changed record waking.
The candidate does not touch `src/host/throughput-watchdog-thresholds.ts`, review, CI or accounting gates.
